name: Unicron
tagline: Compiles your overlapping bots and routines into one fleet document
description: Reads the bots, instruction sets and routines you have built up and turns the overlap into one document covering your profile, your fleet and your routines. It finishes with a diff of what it found, then stops and waits. Nothing changes until you approve the proposal, and it does not carry changes out itself.
author: the_Arow_H
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
